parsed.observations: Detached wheat leaves show numerous whitish, powdery-looking colonies, some merging into extensive grey-tan coatings with dark specks. Scattered orange-brown pustules are also visible, with yellowing and substantial brown, dead tissue on several leaves.
parsed.summary: Powdery mildew is most prominent, supported by extensive whitish surface colonies, with concurrent leaf rust indicated by scattered orange-brown pustules.
